podcast.body: A song from *Nevermind* where Kurt Cobain shares songwriting credit with Chad Powers. This shared credit is attributed to the "yelping at the beginning of the song," which consists of lyrics from "Get Together," a song written by Powers and originally performed by The Youngbloods. "While pissing is shared with chat powers of the band Quick Silver Messenger Service, the reason is the yelping at the beginning of the song, which are lyrics from the song Get Together by the Youngbloods, a song written by Powers."
